title: Node .status.nodeInfo.kubeProxyVersion may stop being published

detection.reason: whether the gate is enabled is kubelet/apiserver process configuration, which is not collected; the field's presence on Node status today does not say what it will be after the upgrade

quote: Added the `DisableNodeKubeProxyVersion` feature gate. If `DisableNodeKubeProxyVersion` is enabled, the `kubeProxyVersion` field is not set.
remediation: Anything reading `.status.nodeInfo.kubeProxyVersion` — dashboards, drift checks, admission policies — must stop treating it as always present. The field was never reliable (it reported the kubelet's compiled-in version, not the running kube-proxy), which is why it is going away.
verifyCommand: kubectl get nodes -o json | jq -r '.items[] | select(.status.nodeInfo.kubeProxyVersion != null) | "\(.metadata.name) \(.status.nodeInfo.kubeProxyVersion)"'  # each node printed still publishes the field; readers of it break when the gate turns on
